title: ProtoGuide: Prototype-Driven Guidance for Class-Conditional Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.15239v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discrete diffusion models are a prominent family for graph generation, but standard class-conditional mechanisms embed the class signal in the denoiser during training, tying the conditioning mechanism to the trained model. Classifier guidance avoids this coupling in continuous domains by steering a frozen model with a classifier's gradient, but discrete graph diffusion samples discrete edge states, so gradients cannot propagate through the sampled graph. We introduce ProtoGuide, a post-hoc, backbone-agnostic framework that recovers an analogous mechanism. At each reverse step the denoiser's per-edge output is relaxed into a differentiable soft adjacency, embedded by a frozen Siamese graph neural network, and scored against a target-class prototype and its nearest competitor; the resulting per-edge gradient, damped by a cosine schedule, is injected back into the denoiser output. translated_title: ProtoGuide：面向类条件图生成的原型驱动引导方法
translated_abstract: 离散扩散模型是图生成领域的一类重要模型，但标准的类条件机制在训练阶段将类别信号嵌入到去噪器中，使得条件化机制与训练好的模型紧密耦合。分类器引导方法在连续域中通过利用分类器的梯度来引导冻结的模型，从而避免了这种耦合问题；然而离散图扩散采样的是离散的边状态，梯度无法通过采样得到的图进行反向传播。为此，我们提出了ProtoGuide，这是一种事后、与骨干网络无关的框架，能够恢复类似的引导机制。在每个反向扩散步骤中，去噪器的逐边输出被松弛为可微的软邻接矩阵，经由冻结的孪生图神经网络进行嵌入，并与目标类别原型及其最近竞争者进行对比评分；所产生的逐边梯度经余弦调度衰减后被重新注入到去噪器的输出中。所有组件均保持冻结状态，因此引导可以灵活地重新定向（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: ProtoGuide提出了一种事后、骨干网络无关的类条件图生成引导框架，通过将去噪器输出松弛为可微软邻接矩阵，利用冻结的孪生图神经网络与类别原型对比评分并注入衰减后的逐边梯度，在离散图扩散中实现了类似连续域分类器引导的机制，且所有组件无需重新训练即可灵活切换目标类别。
en_tdlr: ProtoGuide is a post-hoc, backbone-agnostic framework that recovers classifier-guidance-like mechanisms for discrete graph diffusion by relaxing the denoiser's per-edge output into a differentiable soft adjacency, scoring it against target-class prototypes via a frozen Siamese GNN, and injecting cosine-damped per-edge gradients back into the denoiser with all components kept frozen.
